The control plane tax is gone. Next: your hypervisor tax.

Introducing kMetal 1.0 by CLASTIX! 

Real #Kubernetes tenant isolation on shared #BareMetal: a separate kernel + network per tenant. No dedicated hardware, no separate #hypervisor layer to license or run.

→ https://clastix.io/post/introducing-k-metal-1-0-for-helping-enterprises-control-and-scale-kubernetes-more-efficiently
